This world checks two things of the world system and writes no paper.

paper-repo: (1) Through the worlds resource, continue the world rw_fb7877809dad from its checkpoint c0, with a configuration file you write in your own files: the full effective configuration that `researchworld config show rw_fb7877809dad` prints, unchanged, with "resources": [] written out.
